episodes.label: The Scan That Chose the Radiation — Ga-68 vs. Lu-177 DOTATATE Somatostatin Receptor 2 Theranostics, Lysine/Arginine Megalin Renal Dosimetry Protection & NETTER-1 Neuroendocrine Tumor Progression-Free Survival
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 121: Ga-68 vs. Lu-177 DOTATATE Somatostatin Receptor 2 Theranostics, Lysine/Arginine Megalin Renal Dosimetry Protection & NETTER-1 Neuroendocrine Tumor Progression-Free Survival. A metastatic ileal neuroendocrine tumor grows despite long-acting octreotide. The Critical Care Clinician follows the biopsy, the receptor scan and the safety labs. The Molecular Pharmacologist follows a cyclic peptide and the different signals made by two radionuclides. The patient, measurements and dialogue are fictional. The notebook source, *DOCS_ARCHIVE_RADIOPHARMACEUTICALS_AND_NUCLEAR_MEDICINE.md*, introduces DOTATATE, DOTA chemistry and the NETTER trials. Pharmacology notebook

episodes.label: The Stain That Changed the Prescription — Equivocal HER2 IHC (2+) Reflexed to Dual-Probe ISH, Humanized Clone 4D5 Trastuzumab at Domain IV (PDB 1N8Z), Slamon Metastatic Trial & Serial LVEF Cardiotoxicity Surveillance
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 115: Equivocal HER2 IHC (2+) Reflexed to Dual-Probe ISH, Humanized Clone 4D5 Trastuzumab at Domain IV (PDB 1N8Z), Slamon Metastatic Trial & Serial LVEF Cardiotoxicity Surveillance. A breast biopsy shows enough HER2 staining to raise a question the stain alone cannot answer. The Critical Care Clinician follows the report from the tissue block to the oncology visit, then opens two echocardiograms side by side. The Molecular Pharmacologist traces the antibody from mouse clone 4D5 to the human HER2 interface. The patient, values and dialogue are fictional. The notebook anchor is chapter 18, “Physiological and Laboratory Markers of Drug Effect,” in *Principles of Clinical Pharmacology*, third edition (2012), which discusses HER2 testing for Herceptin. Pharmacology notebook

episodes.label: The Drug That Jammed the Proteasome — Bortezomib Boronic Acid Tetrahedral Adduct at Human 20S Beta-5 Thr1 (PDB 5LF3), Myeloma Free-Light-Chain Cast Recovery (APEX) & Subcutaneous Neuropathy Reduction (Moreau)
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology Pilot 93: Bortezomib Boronic Acid Tetrahedral Adduct at Human 20S Beta-5 Thr1 (PDB 5LF3), Myeloma Free-Light-Chain Cast Recovery (APEX) & Subcutaneous Neuropathy Reduction (Moreau). A serum protein peak shrinks, creatinine falls, and a patient says the bedsheet now hurts his feet. Follow the drug from a boron atom to three different clinical readouts. The patient, dialogue and patient-level values are fictional. The notebook anchor is Hewitt, Carroll and Korolchuk’s 2015 chapter “Mechanisms of Cross-Talk between Intracellular Protein Degradation Pathways,” which discusses bortezomib, endoplasmic reticulum stress and resistance involving PSMB5. Pharmacology notebook · Chapter 5

episodes.label: One Ångström from a Dividing Cell — Paclitaxel in the β-Tubulin Taxane Pocket (1JFF), Cremophor Anaphylaxis & Mitotic Spindle Fate
episodes.notes: Atomic-scale journey into the luminal beta-tubulin taxane pocket (PDB 1JFF): distinguishing Cremophor EL complement-mediated infusion anaphylaxis from delayed neutropenia, M-loop lateral protofilament stabilization, and multipolar mitotic spindle catastrophe in human tumors.

episodes.label: Tracking Mutant Estrogen Receptors and Insulin in Breast Cancer
episodes.notes: Molecular and transcriptomic dissection of clonal evolution in ER+ breast cancer, focusing on mutant estrogen receptor Helix-12 stabilization and the "insulin boomerang" effect. Analyzes TCGA datasets regarding FABP4 expression in tumor-associated macrophages and its role in promoting metabolic reprogramming and metastatic migration.

episodes.label: How Belzutifan Switches Off Kidney Cancer Pseudohypoxia
episodes.notes: Pharmacological inhibition of hypoxia-inducible factor-2 alpha by belzutifan in the treatment of von Hippel-Lindau disease-associated renal cell carcinoma. Examines the molecular reversal of pseudohypoxic signaling and the clinical resolution of paraneoplastic syndromes like Stauffer's cholestasis during targeted therapy.

episodes.label: Carcinoid Heart Valves and Teenage Fibrolamellar Liver Coma
episodes.notes: Biochemical and histopathological dissection of carcinoid heart valve plaque formation driven by hyperserotonemia alongside DNAJB1-PRKACA fusion gene tumorigenesis in adolescent fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma. Examines tricuspid leaflet fibrosis, nicotinamide depletion niacin deficiency pellagra, and multi-organ metabolic crises.

episodes.label: Curing Stomach Lymphoma With Antibiotics Versus Diffuse CDH1
episodes.notes: Molecular and oncogenic resolution of gastric malignancies, contrasting the antibiotic-responsive H. pylori-associated MALT lymphoma with the aggressive CDH1-mutant diffuse adenocarcinoma. Analyzes the "leather-bottle" stomach phenotype alongside the malignant arc of viral and bacterial drivers in precision oncology.

episodes.label: The Cancer Order Sheet — Tumor Markers, Liquid Biopsy & Theranostics
episodes.notes: Oncological and molecular pathology examination of cancer workups, tumor markers, and circulating tumor DNA liquid biopsy pitfalls. Explores the biological landmines of mutation-only ctDNA assays alongside marrow flow cytometry, solid-tumor NGS panels, and targeted theranostic PET imaging agents.

episodes.label: Escorting One Actinium Atom From Birth to a Tumor
episodes.notes: Atomic and pharmacokinetic tracking of Actinium-225 from its cyclotronic origin to its targeted deposition within the tumor cell nucleus. Examines the precision biophysics of radioligand chelation and the 1-Ångström molecular machinery required to deliver high-LET alpha radiation while sparing adjacent healthy parenchyma.

episodes.label: When Targeted Drugs Trigger Systemic Collapse
episodes.notes: Pharmacodynamic dissection of targeted biologic therapies and systemic inflammatory collapse. Examines how exogenous molecular agents disrupt complex homeostatic feedback networks and trigger severe immunogenic toxicities.

episodes.label: How Monoclonal Antibodies Trigger Immune Self-Destruction
episodes.notes: Immunological and toxicological dissection of engineered CD28 superagonist monoclonal antibodies that bypass T-cell co-stimulation checkpoints to unleash catastrophic cytokine release syndrome. Reconstructs how species-specific Fc and memory-T-cell differences turned preclinical safety models into acute multi-organ failure.

episodes.label: Targeting Resistant Prostate Cancer With Lutetium Radioligands
episodes.notes: Molecular and radiotherapeutic resolution of Lutetium-177-PSMA-617 targeting in castration-resistant AR-V7 prostate cancer. Synthesizes the Razavi three-compartment molecular audit of circulating cell-free DNA and matched white blood cells to refine the liquid beta crossfire and improve precision oncology outcomes in the ivory spine.

episodes.label: Succinate Oncometabolites and the Paraganglioma Beta Blocker Trap
episodes.notes: Mechanistic synthesis of familial SDHB-mutated metastatic paraganglioma, exploring succinate oncometabolite accumulation and hypoxia-inducible factor stabilization. Evaluates the perilous pharmacologic interactions of beta-blocker therapy in catecholamine-secreting neuroendocrine tumors.

episodes.label: Cracking Previously Untreatable GIST Tumors With Avapritinib
episodes.notes: Precision oncological resolution of the PDGFRA D842V mutation in gastrointestinal stromal tumors previously classified as untreatable. Analyzes the molecular targeting of avapritinib as a paradigm shift in the management of rare malignant arcs, focusing on the structural inhibition of mutant receptors that bypass traditional tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

episodes.label: Waldenstrom Hyperviscosity Blood Sludge and Coated Aortas
episodes.notes: Clinical and biochemical reconstruction of Waldenström macroglobulinemia and the rheological consequences of IgM-mediated hyperviscosity. Details the pathophysiology of sausage-link retinas and coated aortas alongside the molecular targeting of BRAF V600E histiocytosis within the malignant arc of rare hematologic and oncogenic disorders.

episodes.label: The Protein the Stain Could Not Name — Cardiac Lambda AL Amyloidosis With Positive Bone Scintigraphy (H029), Gillmore Nonbiopsy Specificity & Laser-Microdissection LC-MS/MS Typing
episodes.notes: Diagnostic decision rules and proteomic tissue typing in cardiac amyloidosis (H029): Nguyen et al.'s (2021) lambda light-chain AL cardiac amyloidosis case with strongly positive technetium pyrophosphate uptake, Gillmore et al.'s (2016) dual requirement of Grade 2/3 bone scintigraphy AND complete absence of monoclonal protein in serum/urine, Congo red birefringence limits, and Vrana (2009) & Mollee (2016, 121/131) laser-microdissection LC-MS/MS subtyping.

episodes.label: Two Counts for One Clone — Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria Budd-Chiari Thrombosis (H030), RBC Hemolysis/Transfusion Dilution vs. Granulocyte FLAER/CD157 Flow Cytometry
episodes.notes: Flow-cytometric lineage gating and survival bias in Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (H030): why red-cell CD55/CD59 clone fractions dramatically underestimate granulocyte/monocyte PNH clone size after complement hemolysis and transfusion in Budd-Chiari syndrome, Brodsky's fluorescent aerolysin (FLAER) binding to GPI anchors, CD157 single-tube multi-lineage validation, and Fattizzo et al.'s clone-evolution cohort.

episodes.label: How Scientists Followed Carbon Through a Tumor — Warburg's 1927 Artery-Vein Lactate Balance, DeBerardinis's 13C NMR Glioblastoma TCA & Glutaminolysis & Hensley's Intraoperative Lung Tumor Infusions
episodes.notes: From the classical Warburg Effect to human intraoperative stable-isotope tracing: Warburg, Wind & Negelein (1927) aerobic glycolysis across rat tumor vessels, DeBerardinis et al. (2007) 13C NMR isotopomer resolution of simultaneous glycolysis, TCA flux, fatty acid synthesis, and glutamine anaplerosis in glioblastoma cells, and Hensley et al. (2016) intraoperative [U-13C]glucose infusions in human NSCLC patients.

episodes.label: Villi, Low-Protein Cytolysis, and Silicone Gels — Veterinary GI Endoscopy, Corn-Oil Lacteals & Feline Ileal Lymphoma (V036), CSF Lumbar Flow, 30-Min Lysis & Neuro-FIP Cure (V037) & Vet TDM, SST Gel Traps & Feline KBr Asthma Ban (V038)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary GI endoscopy (V036), CSF analysis (V037), and veterinary TDM (V038): left lateral positioning, Fleet enema ban, corn-oil lacteals, and feline ileal-only T-cell lymphoma (18-39%); pre-tap MRI, lumbar vs. cisternal CSF, 30-60m oncotic lysis rescue (10% serum/Hetastarch), SRMA IgA, GS-441524 neuro-FIP cure, and equine EPM SAG ratios; and plain red-top vs. SST phenobarbital trap, feline KBr/diazepam bans, KBr chloride kinetics, cyclosporine IL-2 mRNA PD, and feline methimazole CKD unmasking.

episodes.label: Tears, Stria Melanocytes, and Spinal Arcs — Veterinary Ophthalmic Exam, Descemetocele 'Donut Hole' & TonoVet Physics (V033), BAER Deafness Screening, MITF/PMEL Stria Collapse & Cavalier PSOM (V034) & Neurologic Localization, Schiff-Sherrington & the Deep Pain Law (V035)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary ophthalmology/tonometry (V033), BAER deafness screening (V034), and neurologic localization (V035): STT-I sequence, cherry-eye gland preservation, descemetocele fluorescein 'donut hole', collar/species TonoVet traps, and fellow-eye glaucoma prophylaxis; Strain's >12,000 Dalmatian registry, MITF/KIT stria melanocytes, OFA >=35d rule, and Cavalier PSOM bone BAER; and 4 spinal segments, Schiff-Sherrington, paradoxical vestibular tilt, and Olby's Deep Pain & Progressive Myelomalacia laws.

episodes.label: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
episodes.notes: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.

episodes.label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.

episodes.label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
episodes.notes: Dissecting in-vitro potassium artifacts before the analyzer: Mansoor et al. (2015) reverse pseudohyperkalemia (9.5 mmol/L across three analyzers vs. 3.7 mmol/L on hand-carried whole blood due to pneumatic-tube mechanical lysis of fragile leukemic white cells in heparinized plasma), Xiong et al. (2022) familial cold-induced ABCB6 red-cell potassium leak, and Raffee et al. (2022) why a normal ECG cannot rule out true hyperkalemia.

episodes.label: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
episodes.notes: One Medicine epithelial, mucosal, and surgical pathology deep dive (H028, V019, V032): ASCCP unsatisfactory vs. absent-TZ rules, 2025 SELF-CERV vaginal HPV trial (n=599), HPV FOCAL (n=19,009), European pooled RCTs (n=176,464), English HPV vaccine registry (13.7M person-years), gastric-type adenocarcinoma missed by cone biopsy, Kemp (2015) 70-dog liver biopsy concordance (60%-69%), Marsilio (2019) 12/20 healthy cats called small-cell lymphoma on IHC/PARR, 2026 32-dog STS biopsy undergrading, 94-dog STS 3-year margin recurrence (41.2%/22.5%/7.1%), Barillas (2019) demodicosis hair-pluck vs. deep-scrape monitoring, Díaz (2023) post-cure Malassezia qPCR persistence, and Bizikova (2019) 35-cat pemphigus foliaceus relapses (24/31).

episodes.label: Proviral Hiding Places & Shedding Windows — Feline Leukemia p27 Antigen, FIV Maternal Antibodies & Canine Parvovirus SNAP Traps
episodes.notes: Clinical problem cluster in veterinary virology & Bayesian screening (V027, V028, V001): Feline Leukemia Virus (FeLV) soluble p27 capsid antigen ELISA vs. IFA & quantitative proviral DNA/RNA PCR across abortive, regressive (occult bone-marrow integration transmitted via blood transfusion!), and progressive stages; FIV gp40/p24 antibody testing vs. colostral maternal antibodies in kittens <6 months & vaccine interference; low-prevalence positive predictive value (PPV) math requiring orthogonal confirmation; paired with Canine Parvovirus (CPV-2a/2b/2c) fecal antigen ELISA false negatives (dilution, mucosal antibody sequestration, narrow shedding window) vs. PCR post-MLV vaccine false positives.

Evaluates the diagnostic sensitivity of low-dose CT and lipoprotein(a) assays in preventing occult cardiovascular catastrophes, bridging the gap between population-level data and individual clinical risk.

episodes.label: The Evolution of Cancer Diagnosis and Survival
episodes.notes: Clinical and historical reconstruction of oncological diagnostics, from ancient humoral theories of black bile to modern precision molecular profiling. Evaluates the association between CD163-positive tumor-associated macrophages and breast cancer survival, specifically examining how obesity-induced lipid accumulation alters the tumor microenvironment.

episodes.label: Why Cancer Isn't Just a Physical Lump
episodes.notes: Clinical and biochemical investigation of paraneoplastic syndromes, such as erythema gyratum repens, as systemic physiological alarms for occult malignancies. Integrates the 2025 American Cancer Society Disparities Report with next-generation molecular diagnostics to redefine cancer as a multi-organ disruptor rather than a localized physical mass.

episodes.label: How Zip Codes Predict Cancer Survival
episodes.notes: Epidemiological and clinical oncology investigation of how residential zip codes, environmental carcinogen exposure, and diagnostic access disparities stratify cancer survival. Synthesizes geospatial mortality gradients, screening bottlenecks, and structural determinants that shape stage-at-presentation and treatment outcomes.

episodes.label: Why Lifesaving Cancer Drugs and Isotopes Vanish
episodes.notes: Logistical supply chain analysis of medical isotope radioactive decay and chemotherapeutic drug shortages. Evaluates the fragile infrastructure governing clinical access to short-lived diagnostic radiotracers and vital oncology therapeutics.

episodes.label: How a Cheap Cancer Cure Vanished
episodes.notes: Pharmacoeconomic and oncological audit of how generic cisplatin—a curative, off-patent platinum therapeutic achieving over 90% survival in testicular cancer—vanished from hospital shelves. Examines sterile-injectable manufacturing concentration, razor-thin generic pricing margins, and rationing crises across cancer wards.

episodes.label: The Letter the First Test Missed — Compound Heterozygous DPYD Variants Missed by 4-SNP Panels (de Haar-Holleman 2024), Fluorouracil Catabolism Collapse & Uridine Triacetate Antidote Rescue
episodes.notes: Pharmacogenomics and biochemical rescue of fluoropyrimidine toxicity: why targeted 4-variant DPYD genotyping misses rare in-trans compound heterozygotes (de Haar-Holleman et al. 2024), phenotypic DPD uracil breath/plasma assays (Coenen et al. 2019), 5-FU catabolic shunting into FUTP/FdUMP (Peters et al. 1988), and emergency antidote rescue with uridine triacetate (Jacob et al. 2022).

episodes.label: The Drug That Quieted the First Wave — Ondansetron & Cisplatin Emesis, 5-HT3A Cryo-EM (PDB 6W1M), Acute 5-HT3 vs. Delayed Substance P/NK1 Phase, hERG QTc Risk & CYP2D6 CPIC
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology of ondansetron and biphasic chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting: Cubeddu & Marty's 1990 cisplatin trials, 2.8 Å cryo-EM structure of 5-HT3A bound to ondansetron (PDB 6W1M), why acute (0–24h) peripheral 5-HT3 vagal signaling gives way to delayed (24–120h) central NK1/Substance P signaling, hERG K+ channel blockade and FDA IV dose caps, and CPIC CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizer guidance.

episodes.label: The Breath Before the Heat — Rising End-Tidal CO2 Before Hyperthermia, Skeletal Muscle RyR1 Calcium Leak, Dantrolene Channel Stabilization & Post-Crisis IVCT/CHCT vs. RYR1 Genetic Testing
episodes.notes: Intraoperative malignant hyperthermia from capnography to channel biophysics: why rising end-tidal carbon dioxide precedes core temperature elevation, uncontrolled skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor (RyR1) sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release, dantrolene sodium stabilization of RyR1, and post-crisis workup integrating RYR1 variant sequencing with caffeine-halothane contracture testing.

episodes.label: The Sugar That Stayed in the Scan — [18F]FDG from 1976–1979 Brain Autoradiography (Sokoloff & Reivich) and Cyclotron 109.77-Min Decay to GLUT3/Hexokinase II Trapping (4ZW9/2NZT), Thoracic SUVmax 7.2 & EBUS Granulomas
episodes.notes: From cyclotron target to thoracic staging needle: Sokoloff's 1977 [14C]deoxyglucose method and Reivich/Alavi/Phelps's 1976-1979 human [18F]FDG brain studies, Hamacher nucleophilic synthesis and 109.77-minute half-life batch logistics (21 CFR 212.70), D-glucose-bound GLUT3 (PDB 4ZW9) and human hexokinase II (PDB 2NZT) metabolic trapping, 511-keV coincidence physics and SUVbw math (7.2 g/mL), and why bilateral FDG-avid mediastinal nodes still require EBUS-TBNA tissue confirmation (granulomatous inflammation vs. metastasis).

episodes.label: The Drug That Cut the Drug — Glucarpidase Methotrexate Rescue, DAMPA Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. HPLC/LC-MS/MS (5.79 vs. 2.27 µmol/L at Hour 117, Gulley 2020), Ogawa Tissue Rebound & Organ Recovery
episodes.notes: Enzymatic drug cleavage and analytical cross-reactivity after high-dose methotrexate rescue with glucarpidase (carboxypeptidase G2): Gulley et al.'s (2020) split specimen 74 hours post-glucarpidase reading 5.79 µmol/L by immunoassay vs. 2.27 µmol/L by HPLC due to DAMPA metabolite persistence beyond the nominal 48-hour VORAXAZE label window, Ogawa et al.'s (2024) 98.83% 20-minute plasma drop and tissue rebound, and Corbisier et al.'s (2024) multimodal pediatric liver/renal recovery.

episodes.label: Shadows, Acoustic Windows & Operator Hands — Two-View Veterinary Radiography, Ultrasound Artifacts, Twisted Stomachs & Missing Stones
episodes.notes: One Medicine diagnostic imaging deep dive (V013, V014, H005, H032): 5 radiographic opacities & 3-view thoracic gravity physics, ICRP/ACVR collimation vs. digital cropping eye-lens scatter, AI dataset shift traps, pulmonary metastasis CT vs. X-ray size thresholds, counterclockwise canine GDV missed as sand impaction, Vizsla shotgun survival vs. Cane Corso forensic necropsy, Hermann's tortoise retained egg, paired with B-mode ultrasound physics, AFAST fluid scores vs. centesis, feline moth-eaten spleen & canine cavitated splenic hemangiosarcoma myths (42% Se / 51% Sp), feline ureteroliths, liver biopsy PCV drops, and equine colic FLASH.

episodes.label: Shoulders of Giants — Immunometabolism & Oncology: FABP4 & FABP5 Lipid Chaperones in Dietary Fat, Psoriasis, Ferroptosis & Metastasis
episodes.notes: Five-Act immunometabolic and oncology synthesis tracing intracellular fatty acid-binding proteins from Robert Ockner's 1972 discovery, 10-stranded beta-barrel crystallography, Gokhan Hotamisligil's FABP4/aP2 metabolic-inflammation paradigm, and Brent Stockwell's discovery of ferroptosis (2012) to Bing Li's discovery of macrophage FABP4 vs FABP5 subset specialization—unpacking how FABP5 links dietary saturated vs omega-3 fats and the keratinocyte FABP5-VCP complex to cutaneous IL-36/NF-kB/IL-1b psoriatic inflammation (Cell Reports 2022, 2023, 2025), while FABP4-driven macrophage lipid accumulation and ATGL lipolysis fuel breast cancer metastasis (eLife 2024, PMC11548877) and omega-3 PUFAs trigger CD36/FABP5 tumor ferroptosis.

episodes.notes: Separating stool hemoglobin screening, mucosal adduct biology, and observational nutritional epidemiology: FIT buffer-to-feces (µg Hb/g) conversion, human MGMT Cys145 suicidal O6-methylguanine repair (PDB 1EH6/1T38), Le Leu et al. (2015) randomized high-red-meat ± butyrylated resistant starch rectal biopsy O6MeG adduct trial, and gene-by-diet interaction studies.

episodes.label: What a Bright Spot on a PET Scan Is Made Of — Sokoloff's 1977 [14C]Deoxyglucose Hexokinase Trap, Reivich & Phelps's 1979 Human [18F]FDG-PET & Kubota's 1992 Macrophage Microautoradiography
episodes.notes: Biochemical basis and diagnostic specificity of [18F]FDG-PET (H022): Sokoloff et al.'s (1977) hexokinase metabolic trapping of 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, Reivich & Phelps's (1979) human positron emission tomography translation, Som et al.'s (1980) oncologic uptake, and Kubota et al.'s (1992) cellular microautoradiography proving why activated macrophages and granulation tissue generate intense FDG avidity indistinguishable from cancer on a single SUV number.

episodes.label: How a Cell Builds Insulin from One Chain — Sanger's Two-Chain Disulfide Puzzle, Steiner & Oyer's 1967 Human Islet Tumor Pulse-Chase Proinsulin Precursor & Equimolar C-Peptide Secretion
episodes.notes: Discovery of prohormone processing: why isolated insulin A and B chains recombine inefficiently in vitro, Steiner & Oyer (1967) identification of single-chain proinsulin in human islet-cell adenoma slices, pulse-chase proof of intracellular proteolytic conversion into two-chain insulin, and Rubenstein, Clark & Steiner (1969) equimolar C-peptide co-secretion enabling clinical distinction between endogenous and exogenous insulin.

episodes.label: The Seed the Scan Could Not Name — Adult Occult Sapodilla Seed Aspiration (Nguyen Phan 2026), Two-Year Unilateral Wheeze & Flexible Bronchoscopy Extraction (H049)
episodes.notes: Pulmonary diagnostics and flexible bronchoscopy (H049) for occult adult airway foreign bodies: Nguyen Phan et al.'s (2026) two-year missed sapodilla seed aspiration masquerading as recurrent right-lower-lobe pneumonia and asthma, radiolucent organic foreign-body CT physics, granulation-tissue tumor mimics, and flexible vs. rigid bronchoscopic retrieval across adult cohorts (Jang et al. 2022; Purohit et al. 2023).

episodes.label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of tissue histopathology (H029), multiparameter flow cytometry (H030), and veterinary helical CT (V016): cold ischemia, formalin kinetics, Elmore's 240x115 breast biopsy concordance and STR floater checks; MBL, TRBC1, COG/EuroFlow MRD, and anti-CD19 lineage switch; and canine lung staging (41/459 nodules on X-ray), breath-hold recruitment, 66-dog portosystemic shunt CTA, and caval tumor-thrombus mapping.

episodes.label: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
episodes.notes: One Medicine gastrointestinal endoscopy and mucosal biopsy investigation (H047 & V036): why optically normal human esophageal mucosa can conceal severe eosinophilic esophagitis (169 eosinophils/HPF) unless multilevel biopsies are taken, why canine gastric masses mimicking neoplasia on endoscopy require submucosal histology and special stains, and patchy sampling error.

episodes.label: Calcified Heart Toothpaste, Telescoping Arteries and Micro Tumors
episodes.notes: Forensic pathology investigation of occult cardiovascular catastrophes, including calcified coronary plaque, telescoping arteries, and AV-node micro-tumors. Details subtle postmortem diagnostic red flags and clinical imaging traps that conceal lethal sudden cardiac death mechanisms.

episodes.label: Cytogenetics & Long-Read Genomics — Karyotypes, Dual-Fusion FISH, SNP Arrays & Nanopore
episodes.notes: Structural and molecular resolution of human constitutional genomics using 550-band karyotypes, dual-fusion FISH, and SNP microarrays. Evaluates the diagnostic utility of Nanopore long-read sequencing for pseudogene resolution and the implementation of ACMG 2021 guidelines in identifying germline variants and hematopoietic architecture.

episodes.label: Blood Banking & Hemostasis Mechanics — 11-Cell Rule-Outs, Daratumumab DTT & VWD Multimers
episodes.notes: Immunohematological and kinetic analysis of blood bank rule-out algorithms, Daratumumab-induced DTT interference, and von Willebrand factor multimer distribution. Integrates the Darwinian mechanics of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) with the daily production of 100 billion neutrophils from hematopoietic stem cell pools.

episodes.label: Infectious Disease Serology & Virology — Syphilis Algorithms, Hepatitis Windows & Tick Panels
episodes.notes: Comparative diagnostic evaluation of the syphilis reverse algorithm, hepatitis core windows, and multiplexed stool pathogen panels for Shiga-toxin producing E. coli. Analyzes the Poisson multipliers of gut shedding alongside the clinical sensitivity of Western blot and NAAT multistep algorithms in human and veterinary infectious disease.

episodes.label: Endocrinology Dynamic Testing — Dexamethasone Suppression, Adrenal Veins & Metanephrines
episodes.notes: Comparative physiological analysis of endocrine feedback loops using dexamethasone suppression, adrenal vein sampling, and metanephrine assays. Examines the ultradian dynamics of cortisol secretion and the diagnostic challenges of hyperadrenocorticism where random serum levels overlap between healthy, stressed, and pathological states.

episodes.label: Gastroenterology, Hepatology & Nutrition — Liver R-Factor, SAAG, Manometry & Breath Physics
episodes.notes: Clinical and biophysical dissection of hepatobiliary diagnostics and metabolic flux, focusing on the R-factor for liver injury and the serum-ascites albumin gradient. Integrates Chicago classification manometry with experimental tray weighback studies and breath physics to quantify energy expenditure and gastrointestinal efficiency.

episodes.label: Cardiopulmonary Diagnostics & Hemodynamics — Vector Loops, hs-cTn, Cath-Lab FFR & DLCO
episodes.notes: Clinical and physiological reconstruction of cardiopulmonary hemodynamics using vector loops, high-sensitivity troponin kinetics, and fractional flow reserve (FFR) in the catheterization lab. Evaluates the physics of body-box plethysmography and DLCO measurements to differentiate between obstructive and restrictive pulmonary pathologies.

episodes.label: The Jeopardy! Grandmaster Tour — Microbiology, Fluid Taps & Classic Diagnostic Tests
episodes.notes: Diagnostic audit of clinical microbiology and fluid analysis principles. Examines MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry identification, polarized crystal microscopy, and classic physiological provocation tests across complex internal medicine presentations.

episodes.label: From Womb to Heel-Stick — NIPT, Tandem MS, Sweat Chloride & Trio Exomes
episodes.notes: Clinical and genomic audit of the diagnostic pipeline from prenatal cell-free DNA screening to tandem mass spectrometry heel-stick analysis and trio exome sequencing. Evaluates the biophysical and statistical parameters of sweat chloride testing and metabolic profiling in the early detection of congenital disorders and oncogenic risk factors.

episodes.label: Eight Colored Tubes & The Core Lab — Automated Chemistry & Immunoassay Traps
episodes.notes: Clinical laboratory audit of automated core chemistry analyzers, ion-selective electrode interferences, and biotin immunoassay sabotage. Details how analytical pre-analytical errors, blindfolded antibody clamps, and chemoinformatics neural networks impact diagnostic safety.

episodes.label: Behind the Yellow-Top Tubes — HLA Typing, Luminex Prozone & Living-Cell Crossmatch
episodes.notes: Clinical and molecular audit of 11-locus HLA next-generation sequencing and Luminex prozone effects in transplant diagnostics. Examines the pre-analytical forensics of yellow-top tubes and the isolation of the buffy coat for living-cell crossmatching, ensuring immunological compatibility and preventing hyperacute rejection in precision oncology.

episodes.label: The Living Kidney Donor Gauntlet — mGFR, Litholink & Split Scans
episodes.notes: Clinical evaluation of living kidney donor evaluation protocols using measured glomerular filtration rate and scintigraphy. Analyzes renal functional reserve, 24-hour urinary metabolic risk panels, and split-scan nephron mass distribution.

episodes.label: 31,000 Years Before Anesthesia: Borneo Cave Amputation & Pleistocene Care
episodes.notes: Archaeopathological and bioarchaeological investigation of the 31,000-year-old Liang Tebo tibial-fibular surgical amputation in Borneo. Synthesizes prehistoric paleosurgery evidence with Shanidar 1 skeletal trauma, Pleistocene care dynamics, and ancestral plant-derived zoopharmacognosy.

episodes.label: An Omega-3's Journey to a Human Thought
episodes.notes: Molecular dynamic simulation of a polyunsaturated fatty acid’s transit from dietary ingestion to synaptic integration within the human central nervous system. Traces the biochemical odyssey through the vascular endothelium and blood-brain barrier to elucidate the biophysical role of lipids in modulating cognitive architecture.

episodes.label: Ancient Parasites and Modern Health Politics
episodes.notes: Paleopathological and economic investigation of how parasitic infections like hookworm and malaria shaped colonial history and global health policy. Explores the evolutionary legacy of the Neolithic transition, where adaptation to ancient pathogens inadvertently increased the modern propensity for non-communicable autoimmune disorders.

episodes.label: Anosognosia and How Stroke Erases Half of Reality
episodes.notes: Neurological and neuropsychological investigation of anosognosia and right temporal-parietal junction stroke leading to left-sided neglect. Explores how acute focal brain lesions disrupt internal body schema representation, causing patients to vehemently deny paralysis and perceptual deficits.

episodes.label: Antifreeze Crystal Kidneys and the Hospital Lactate Lie
episodes.notes: Pharmacokinetic and forensic dissection of ethylene glycol toxicity and the diagnostic pitfalls of the "lactate lie" in metabolic crises. Reconstructs a clinical case of Streptococcus pyogenes sepsis and necrotic fascia where clindamycin and vascular volume management resolved hyperlactatemia while preventing antifreeze-induced renal failure.

episodes.label: Assembly Unfurling and Lysis by the Complement MAC
episodes.notes: Structural and biophysical resolution of the 100-angstrom complement membrane attack complex, tracing C5b-9 polymerization and transmembrane pore formation. Analyzes the molecular machinery of targeted cellular lysis, immunopathology, and cell-membrane disruption.

episodes.label: Autoimmune Psychosis and Anti NMDA Receptor Encephalitis
episodes.notes: Clinical and immunopathological dissection of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis triggered by paraneoplastic ovarian teratomas. Synthesizes cerebrospinal fluid analysis with neuroimaging to differentiate autoimmune psychosis from primary psychiatric disorders, highlighting the molecular mechanisms of receptor internalisation and recovery.

episodes.label: Baked Clay & Sacred Reed: Sakikkū Tablets & Twelve Egyptian Papyri
episodes.notes: Archaeological and physiological audit of Bronze Age Mesopotamian cuneiform diagnostics within Esagil-kin-apli's forty Sakikkū tablets and twelve surviving Egyptian medical papyri. Evaluates clinical prognosis models, herbal pharmacology, and nosological categorization across Nippur texts and the Edwin Smith and Ebers papyri.

episodes.label: Boiling Oil, Mercury Tubs & Antimony Pills: Great Iatrogenic Disasters
episodes.notes: Comparative iatrogenic audit of Renaissance surgical failures, from Giovanni da Vigo’s boiling elderberry oil to the toxic sequelae of Paracelsian mercury fumigation wards. Evaluates the 1537 accidental trial of Ambroise Paré alongside the pharmacologic persistence of reusable antimony pills and misdiagnosed sterile neutrophilic ulcers.

episodes.label: Building Digital Twins of Human Cells
episodes.notes: Computational and metabolic reconstruction of human cells using AI-driven digital twins to bridge the gap between single-atom measurements and whole-cell dynamics. Integrates labeled glucose flux data from glioblastoma models with the citric acid cycle to refine next-generation drug discovery through high-fidelity molecular scene synthesis.

episodes.label: Catching Secret Insulin Overdoses With C Peptide
episodes.notes: Forensic and pharmacokinetic dissection of surreptitious insulin administration through the diagnostic ratio of exogenous insulin to endogenous C-peptide. Evaluates postmortem drug redistribution and metabolic traps in the context of JFS forensic toxicology to distinguish between insulinoma-induced hypoglycemia and intentional overdose.

episodes.label: Celiac Gluten Storms Fava Beans and Arctic Genetics
episodes.notes: Clinical and biochemical dissection of immunogenic cell death triggered by dietary gluten, fava beans, and Arctic metabolic adaptations. Synthesizes the pathophysiology of Celiac ZED1227 inhibition alongside G6PD deficiency and CPT1A variants to explain how ancestral nutritional stressors shaped modern gastrointestinal and enzymatic sensitivities.
